chunks: They surely take it to be far away,

key_terms.يَرَوْنَهُ: They take it to be / They see it

ai.seo_question: Why do disbelievers consider the Day of Judgment to be far away?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse critiques the psychological complacency of the disbelievers who view the Resurrection as temporally remote, thereby justifying their moral negligence in the present. This perception of distance is not merely chronological but spiritual, reflecting a failure to internalize the inevitability of divine accountability. The verse serves as a reminder that the 'distant' event is actually imminent for those who lose their spiritual awareness.
